verdict.rationale: HubSpot's API supports creating contact records (hubspot-docs-31) and the official MCP server explicitly grants read/write access to CRM data including contacts and deals for any MCP-compatible agent (hubspot-docs-5, hubspot-docs-30, hubspot-docs-40), which covers the 'create record via API/MCP' part. However, there is no direct evidence of an owner-assignment endpoint/property or company-data enrichment workflow being exposed through the API or MCP server. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of company property/enrichment endpoints, owner assignment via API/MCP, and an end-to-end example showing an agent performing all three steps (create, enrich company data, assign owner) in one flow.
